theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics

The macro backdrop is AI-dominated (28/49 headlines) yet per-theme news is not a trigger. I lean overweight only because it is the sole liquid, non-crowded, high-ranked theme with a investable proxy (515000.SS), and the narrow breadth suggests selective leadership rather than a broad AI bubble.
